title: fix(post): block cutting tools at reserved numbers and names
body:
## What changed

Machine files accept `tooling.reserved` entries.
Each entry reserves a number, a name, or both for `probe` or `tool_setter`.
The reader and validator refuse malformed entries by key.
Stored projects retain the reservations.

New cutting tools skip reserved numbers.
A probe takes a declared probe pocket.
Tool edits and library imports refuse incompatible reserved numbers or names.
Verification and posting also refuse old unsafe assignments.
The existing GUI, script, and MCP commands use these checks.
Tool number zero remains refused.

The standalone post CLI checks its input before it creates or replaces output.
It retains the loaded tool across sections.
A new TOOL needs its own declared kind.
A stream with no tool selector cannot post motion on a machine with reservations.
Indexed lookups keep the checks bounded for long streams.

A machine that omits the field reserves nothing.
No shipped machine file reserves a pocket in this PR (see "Review round 2").

### Project file version 78 (breaking)

A stored machine can hold `reserved_tools`. `PROJECT_VERSION` steps from 77 to 78.
An older reader refuses a v78 file. It cannot drop the reservation and post a cutting tool at a reserved pocket.
The step is a pure step-up: a v77 file opens with no change.
The rule entries are in `crates/app/src/project/file.rs` and `crates/app/src/project/apply.rs`.

PR #3485 merged first and took 77 for the setup `order` key (#3447). This PR takes 78.
Main's v77 meaning is unchanged.

This is a breaking change of the project file.
Commit `8f541fdc3` is `fix(project)!:` and has the `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer.

## Cause

Tool allocation considered only document numbers.
Machine files could not protect a probe pocket or a control-managed tool name.
The app and standalone post paths had no reservation check.

## Review round 2 (second review of `e6881bb0a`)

- Blocker, version step: done (above).
- T99 provenance: removed. I found no public Tormach document that names T99 as the probe pocket.
  The earlier #362 research calls T99 a convention of the PathPilot probing screens only.
  The 18 Tormach files are identical to `main` again. A follow-up can add T99 with a cited document.
- `assets/machines/AGENTS.md`: the `tooling.reserved` row is added.
- MCP text: the `add_tool` description now says that the number skips the machine's reservations.
  It changes in `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs`, `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` and `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`.
- Body: refreshed. Parent #3157 merged, so the stack note and the parent's screenshots are removed.

## Review round 3 (review of `3b5f359ff`)

- Version step: now 78. The constant, the rule entries, the pins, the fixture and the decision say 78.
- NEW blocker, breaking-change marker: commit `8f541fdc3` has the `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer. The history is kept.
- Conflict with `main`: I merged `upstream/main` at `f2b2369ed` with a merge commit (`23685c1c7`).
  - `crates/app/src/project/file.rs` and `apply.rs`: the two sides stay. Main's v77 entry comes first, then the v78 entry of this PR.
  - `crates/app/tests/deburr_chord_width.rs`: main's side is taken. It has the same intent as the earlier change of this PR.

## Screenshots

This PR changes no UI file. No screenshot applies.

## Tests on the final head

Final head: `8f541fdc3`. Base: `upstream/main` at `f2b2369ed` (merged into the branch).

Heavy lanes: not run on this head. AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" (#3556) gives a P6 PR no heavy step.
The reviewer ran the heavy gate on `3b5f359ff`: 212 steps, 0 failed.

| `a_v77_machine_steps_up_with_no_reservation` (same file) | - | - | GREEN |
| `shipped_machines_reserve_no_pocket_without_a_cited_manual` (`crates/post/tests/tool_reservations.rs`) | T99 put back in `tormach-24r.mch` | RED at line 98 | GREEN |

`shipped_machines_reserve_no_pocket_without_a_cited_manual` replaces `shipped_tormach_mills_reserve_t99_for_the_probe`.
`deburr_chord_width` has main's assertion now (at least 76, and the saved version is the current version).

## Goldens moved

- `examples/first-continuous-4axis-part.camproj`: only `"version": 77` changes to `78`. I edited that one line by hand. `continuous_4axis_part` reads the file and passes.
- No NC, CL or catalog program changes.

## Not exercised

- Physical machines, tool changers, or controller sessions.
- Named tool-call execution on a Siemens control.
- An older build that opens a v78 file. The pin proves the version step and the refusal of a newer version.
- Full release tier and pixel snapshot lanes.

## Overlaps

- #3485 merged and took version 77 (see "Project file version 78").
- #3160, #3058, and #3057 touch `crates/app/src/lib.rs` at other module declarations. Whichever merges second refreshes.

Effort: high

Process change: yes (`.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`)

Changelog: Cutting tools skip reserved probe pockets and cannot use reserved tool names. Breaking: project files step to version 78; older builds refuse them.

Fixes #2604
